hotels.name: St Audries Park — stay with us
hotels.description: We would love you to stay at the venue itself. We are block-booking rooms for the night before and the night of the wedding, with dinner and breakfast included.

transport.name: By train
transport.description: Taunton is the nearest mainline station, about half an hour from the venue by taxi.

transport.name: By taxi
transport.description: Local firms know the venue well — book your return journey in advance, especially after midnight.

transport.name: By car
transport.description: St Audries Park is on the A39 at West Quantoxhead, signposted from the main road. Postcode TA4 4DS for sat-nav. There are 4 slow electric charger points at the venue if needed.

parking: Free parking is available at the venue. Cars may be left overnight but must be collected by 10am the next morning.
